_comment: Hand-written task-to-resource relevance judgments for discovery search. Entries are realistic registry resources; queries are things a developer would actually ask. Add cases when a real search misses; never tune a case to make the current ranker pass.

entries.name: Security Review
entries.description: Reviews pull requests for authentication, authorization and injection vulnerabilities.
queries: review this pull request for security vulnerabilities
look for authentication bugs in these changes

entries.name: Playwright Test Writer
entries.description: Generates end-to-end Playwright tests for React pages and flows.
queries: write playwright tests for this page
add end to end browser tests

entries.name: Conventional Commits
entries.description: Writes commit messages that follow the Conventional Commits specification.
queries: write a commit message for these changes
format my commit as conventional commits

entries.name: Alembic Migration Author
entries.description: Writes and reviews Alembic database migrations for SQLAlchemy models.
queries: create a database migration for this model change
review my alembic migration

entries.name: Release Notes Author
entries.description: Summarises merged pull requests into customer-facing release notes.
queries: write release notes for this version
summarise what changed since the last release

entries.name: Accessibility Auditor
entries.description: Checks React components for WCAG accessibility problems and suggests fixes.
queries: check this component for accessibility issues
make this page screen reader friendly

entries.name: Python Performance Profiler
entries.description: Profiles slow Python code paths and recommends optimisations.
queries: why is this python function slow
profile and speed up this code

entries.name: Terraform Plan Reviewer
entries.description: Reviews Terraform plans for destructive changes and drift before apply.
queries: review this terraform plan before I apply it
will this terraform change destroy anything

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Read pull requests, issues, and file contents from GitHub repositories.
queries: list open pull requests in a repository
read a file from a github repo

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.description: Run read-only SQL queries and inspect schemas in PostgreSQL databases.
queries: query our postgres database
show me the schema of a table

entries.name: Snowflake
entries.description: Execute SQL against Snowflake warehouses and browse databases and schemas.
queries: query the snowflake warehouse
run sql on snowflake

entries.name: Linear
entries.description: Create, update and search Linear issues, projects and cycles.
queries: create a linear issue for this bug
what linear issues are assigned to me

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Post messages and read channel history in Slack workspaces.
queries: post an update to the team slack channel
read the latest messages in a slack channel

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Look up Sentry issues, stack traces and release health.
queries: show me the latest sentry errors for this service
what is the stack trace for this sentry issue

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.description: Read, write and search files within an allowed directory tree.
queries: search files in this directory
read and edit local files

entries.name: Browser Automation
entries.description: Drive a headless browser: open pages, click, fill forms and take screenshots.
queries: open a web page and take a screenshot
fill in this form in a browser

entries.name: Pull Request Description
entries.description: Drafts a pull request description with summary, motivation and test plan from a diff.
queries: write a pull request description for this diff
draft the pr summary and test plan

entries.name: Incident Postmortem
entries.description: Structures an incident postmortem: timeline, impact, root cause, action items.
queries: write a postmortem for this incident
structure the root cause analysis

entries.name: API Endpoint Docs
entries.description: Generates reference documentation for an HTTP API endpoint from its handler code.
queries: document this api endpoint
generate openapi style docs for this route

entries.name: Lint on Save
entries.description: Runs the project linter after every file the agent edits.
queries: run the linter after each edit
automatically lint files the agent changes

entries.name: Block Secret Commits
entries.description: Blocks tool calls that would write API keys or credentials into the repository.
queries: stop the agent from committing secrets
prevent api keys being written to files

entries.name: Python Runner
entries.description: Runs untrusted Python in an isolated container with no network access.
queries: run untrusted python code safely
execute this script in an isolated environment

entries.name: Node.js Runner
entries.description: Executes JavaScript and TypeScript in a locked-down Node.js container.
queries: run this javascript in a sandbox
execute typescript safely

entries.name: PR Reviewer
entries.description: Reviews pull requests end to end using GitHub, the security review skill and Linear.
queries: review my pull request
use the pr reviewer agent

entries.name: Data Analyst
entries.description: Answers business questions by querying Snowflake and PostgreSQL and charting results.
queries: analyse our sales data
answer a question from the warehouse

entries.name: On-call Assistant
entries.description: Triages production incidents using Sentry, Slack and the incident postmortem prompt.
queries: help me triage this production incident
what is breaking in production right now
